'''''Trallus' Rustbucket''''' was a dilapidated [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. It was stolen from [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] attempting to escape the [[Taloron Hunters|Taloron Hunter]] [[Crutag]] and his crew of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. While trying to resupply at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]], the ship was shot down by Crutag, who was piloting his own vessel, the ''[[Scent of Fear]]''.
